Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a diffuse reticulonodular pattern with relative sparing of the costophrenic angles and medial bases (consistent with the "medial tip of the right middle lobe" description in option A), which is the classic radiographic distribution for Pulmonary Langerhans' cell histiocytosis; this is further supported by the CT image showing upper/mid-zone predominant cysts and nodules.
